meta.notes: Source of truth for the unification pass. Edit card.status + card.note as decisions get made. Group.status auto-advances when all cards in the group leave 'pending'. sink.js reads this on every request.

groups.label: Tokens · Color
groups.recommendation: Phase 1: three tokens cards mirror the three color families in colors_and_type.css (UI / BRAND / MUSIC). Music card includes interactive controls for --music-count, --music-rotate, --music-c, --note-octave so the recipe is demonstrably correct.

decisions_log.note: Phase 1 token rebuild: deleted colors-neutrals.html, colors-stage-palette.html, colors-jazz-accents.html, colors-chromatic.html. Replaced with tokens-ui-colors.html, tokens-brand-colors.html, tokens-music-colors.html. Dead tokens removed: --saffron, --grape, --coral, --paper, --paper-rise, --cream.

cards.summary: UI chrome: ink-1..5, ivory-1..4, brass + sheen, glass, scrim, hairline. The whole app frame lives here.
Brand poster set: tomato, pine, plum, bone. Decorative only — never on functional chrome.
Chromatic music color recipe (oklch). Interactive: switch between fixed (chromatic) and rooted (scale) modes; adjust --music-count, --music-rotate, --music-c, --note-octave.

groups.label: Type
groups.recommendation: Distinct concerns — keep all three. type-display = specimen, type-mono = specimen, type-text = usage rule (when to switch from Jazz to Mono).

cards.summary: Lets Jazz display typeface in five sizes (56/40/28/22/18px) all-caps with tight tracking.
JetBrains Mono 12px with Strudel syntax preserving punctuation personality.
Rule: Lets Jazz for labels/headlines; switch to Mono only past four words.

groups.label: Spacing · Scale & Radius
groups.recommendation: Keep the two specimens [1][2]. v2's composition-spacing-overview [3] aggregates spacing+radius+stroke+cut-paper marks — duplicates the specimens AND mixes in marks (which live in components-marks). Suggest kill [3].

cards.summary: Nine-step spacing scale, 2px–64px, proportional bar widths.
Six radius tokens (XS 4px → XL 24px) + pill.
v2 aggregate: spacing scale, radius scale, stroke weights, six cut-paper marks.

groups.label: Motion · Foundation (beat, durations, easings)
groups.recommendation: Three distinct concerns — keep all. motion-beat shows tempo concept; durations is the token list; easings is the token list.

cards.summary: Three boxes pulsing at 120/60/240 BPM — beat fundamentals.
Four duration tokens (90/220/360/600ms) shown against a 4-bar timeline.
Five named easing curves (Swing/Stab/Brush/Sustain/Bend) with bezier values and use cases.

groups.label: Motion · Primitives
groups.recommendation: Six distinct motion atoms — keep all. Each shows ONE motion in isolation; the compositions below show them combined.

cards.summary: Knob ring scales 1.04x on quarter notes; downbeat strobe rings saffron.
Panel outer wire heats to brass on bar 1, snaps back.
Knob labels cycle with rip-and-slide animation (skew + fade + translate).
Clicked tile lifts 2px, chromatic ring expands, corner paper-rip.
Persona-5 torn-paper chip slides between tabs; mix-blend-mode difference.
Seven solfège tiles bob 2px on &-of-beat with 30ms stagger.

groups.label: Motion · Compositions
groups.recommendation: Two current compositions are focused (beat-room = 4 motions in sync, state-cascade = 3 motions in sequence). v2 overview [3] aggregates everything with interactive playback. Visual comparison needed. Suggest keep [1][2], kill [3] unless v2's interactive playback is worth saving — in which case merge that interactivity into [1].

cards.summary: Full panel with 4 motion primitives synced: wire strobe, knob pulse, tile bob, badge glow.
Three motions in sequence (tab-slide → mode-rip → played-flash) on a timeline scrubber.
v2 motion overview: easings + interactive beat room + P5 tabs + tile flash + mode knob.

groups.label: Inputs · Tile, Keys, Knob, Button
groups.recommendation: Four distinct input primitives — keep all. Token cleanup needed: components-buttons references deprecated --paper (rewrite to use --ivory).

cards.summary: 130px chromatic-fill tile with syllable, pitch, corner octave; rest/hover/active/played/disabled.
Seven diatonic keypad tiles with cut-paper clip-path, inset shadow, chromatic fill.
Four knob types: range, boolean, options, button. Angular, ivory by default.
Icon buttons in paper / wire / brass / wire-erase roles. References deprecated --paper token.

groups.label: Markers · Badge, Kicker, Marks, Bar Tape
groups.recommendation: Keep [1][2][3][4]. components-chip is mislabeled — it's actually a Hardware Bar composition (instrument, key, BPM, beat counter, VU). Suggest rename → components-hardware-bar.html and move to a Chrome group (or its own composition). Also consider building a real components-chip if you want a chip primitive.

cards.summary: Lets Jazz wordmark in wire box: rest / off-cut / tilted / brass-lit variants, three sizes.
Coloured 9px square + 11px mono line; six colour variants; three sizes.
Two mark families: cut-paper shapes (triangle/disk/zigzag/blade/wave) + music glyphs.
Seven-segment chromatic strip with diatonic width ratios.
Mislabeled — actually a Hardware Bar (instrument, key, BPM, beat counter, VU, scrubber, status LEDs).

groups.label: Containers · Pattern Card, Preset Card, Tabs
groups.recommendation: Three distinct containers — keep all. components-tabs references deprecated --paper, needs the same token cleanup as components-buttons.

cards.summary: Pattern list item: spine, number badge, name, mode/BPM/bars, mini-roll; rest/hover/active/expiring.
Horizontal preset card with ivory border, name, apply button; two-column grid.
Off-cut active tab: skewed, lifted, ivory paper fill, Persona-5 clip-path. References --paper.

groups.label: Parts · Code Strip, Panel Header, Section Anchor
groups.recommendation: Three distinct multi-element assemblies — keep all.

cards.summary: Strudel-style notation row: play head, chromatic syllables, mono timestamps, control buttons.
Panel chrome: badge + meta + icon row (max 3) + glued chromatic bar-tape; three states.
Hero section opener: cut-paper mark, tilted ivory sticker, display heading, lede, chromatic tape footer.

groups.label: Drawer
groups.recommendation: Phase 0: collapsed to single composition card. The instrument/presets/settings panes all live in composition-drawer.html. Surface mechanic + visual-config + top-drawer interactivity demos were deleted; copy preserved in .planning/extracted-copy.md.

decisions_log.note: Phase 0 clutter pass: deleted components-drawer.html, composition-drawer-visual-config.html, composition-top-drawer.html. Renamed composition-drawer-instrument-picker.html -> composition-drawer.html.

cards.summary: Drawer with instrument picker, presets, settings panes; scrim + torn-paper handle.

groups.label: Pattern Reel
groups.recommendation: Phase 0: deck visuals + active-at-bottom interaction merged into one composition card. Surface mechanic kept separate.

decisions_log.note: Phase 0 clutter pass: merged composition-pattern-reel-deck.html (good visuals) + composition-pattern-reel-populated.html (active-at-bottom interaction) into composition-pattern-reel.html. Both source cards deleted.

cards.summary: Empty stacked list chrome: three scaled inactive placeholders above one tall active card.
Stacked deck with click-to-promote interaction; clicking any stacked card swaps it with the active card at the bottom.

groups.label: Brand identity
groups.recommendation: Five distinct brand assets — keep all.

cards.summary: Emotitone wordmark + solfège subtitle + chromatic music note glyphs.
Jazz tagline with collage image illustrating mood.
High-contrast B&W instrument pattern for empty surfaces and brand splashes.
Bitmap instrument stickers for splash screens and empty states.
Loading state: cut-paper anchor, sticker badge, display headline, chromatic progress tape pulsing on beat.

groups.label: Principles
groups.recommendation: Phase 0: rules + antipatterns merged into one canonical principles.html (do/don't pairs). components-card.html stays here pending Phase 4 schema rewrite (it's actually a card-shell spec that will move under primitives/cards).

decisions_log.note: Phase 0 clutter pass: merged principles.html + principles-antipatterns.html into one card with paired rules and antipatterns; emoji-slop antipattern kept as unpaired (no canonical rule).

cards.summary: Five design rules each paired with its visual antipattern. Emoji-slop antipattern is unpaired.
Three principle pillars: dark stage + ivory text, UI warm-neutral vs music chromatic, Jazz + Mono voices.
cards.note: misfiled here; regrouping to primitives/cards in Phase 4
